limitations: User accepted representative motion/art direction on 2026-10-17, reported inverted katana edge and authorized remaining non-skill batch. This corrected c4 has not received final art/runtime approval.
One shared weaponless body and one shared hand occlusion per pose; orthographically projected weapon planes and per-pose front/back flags are a limited trial, not a full body depth solver.
Original design follow-through blade reached the source edge: its full tip is extrapolated from the authored direction and a standard-length reference, not falsely marked observed.
Release forearm was lowered by a real image edit to expose the chin; its grip is recalibrated and original weapon restoration is not an exact pixel reconstruction.
Weapon lengths are render parameters for this trial; no damage/reach/gameplay or equipment UI changes.
New source body is 1254x1254, measured neutral 434px and downsampled to 380px. Windup drops alpha<=96 fringe to retain a clear edge; original source PNG is preserved.

Authored 3D blade/edge axes are orthographically projected using the original guide camera, then rotated in screen space to the measured hand-painted blade direction. This is an authored projection proxy, not 3D reconstruction of the painted actor; body occlusion is per-pose front/back plus hand masks, not a full depth buffer. No edge-on frame is silently exempted.
